records.description: Ostinato / DIA - A lecture examining the parallel relationship between jazz music theory composition technique and ensemble to typography graphic design identity systems and a studios creative process.  April 7th 2016 at the TDC.  Creative Director and Jazz Pianist Mitch Paone (@dia_mitch) will pull back the curtain of DIA and show how musical thinking plays a massive roll in their design process. Hell break down how formal musical training goes hand in hand with the craft of graphic design and typography discuss the concept of ensemble and how that relates to creative collaboration show how music naturally forces @DIA_studios work to behave in flexible time-based format and break down how identity systems are essentially musical compositions in visual form.
